fitness.source: Wu et al. 2016 measured/calibrated S1; S2 imputation excluded
fitness.meaning: WT-normalized binding-selection enrichment; not a direct Kd measurement

ranking.position_order: best first; smaller position is better
ranking.raw_position_correlation: spearman(position, measured_fitness); negative indicates better best-first ordering
ranking.reported_high_score_correlation: spearman(-position, measured_fitness); positive indicates better ordering
ranking.permutation_validation: returned IDs equal the supplied IDs exactly once
ranking.new_true_top_k_ties: measured fitness descending, variant ID ascending
ranking.historical_regression_ties: fixed input order; keep the declared historical rule and version

top_k_overlap.numerator: size of intersection of predicted top k and measured top k in the same evaluation set
top_k_overlap.not_equal_to: fraction of all globally good variants discovered or fraction above WT

first_response_enrichment.unit: raw response candidate entry that maps to S1, before repair; may repeat across records
first_response_enrichment.first_response_scope: first response in every method-round, not only experiment round 1
first_response_enrichment.uniform_reference: actual S1 proportion at or above the stated quantile threshold, including threshold ties
first_response_enrichment.interpretation: descriptive enrichment; not identification of a pretraining-memory mechanism

anchor_success.pair_weighted: average of I(candidate_fitness >= cited_anchor_fitness) over candidate-anchor pairs
anchor_success.candidate_weighted: average over distinct candidate records after averaging their cited-anchor outcomes
anchor_success.measurement_history_eligibility: initial known measurements and earlier fully completed rounds only
anchor_success.prompt_visibility: ID is accompanied by its measured value in the actual supplied prompt; excluded IDs alone do not establish visibility
anchor_success.interpretation: selected, anchor-citing subset; no independent effect of anchor citation

quality.trajectory_mean: mean measured fitness of the selected new variants within one completed trajectory
quality.state_mean: mean of independently generated replicate outcomes within the same condition and source state
quality.state_new_maximum: maximum newly selected measured fitness within one trajectory, before averaging over trajectories/states
quality.cumulative_best: includes initial known measurements and is nondecreasing by definition
quality.sampling_units: states and independently generated episodes/trajectories; proposals and repairs are not independent repetitions

completion.binary_boundary_bootstrap: retain observed proportion, set probability-interval bounds null when the empirical binary distribution is degenerate
completion.conditional_quality: explicitly label quality conditional on completion and report failures alongside it

usage.reported_known_sum: sum reported token counts with missing-call count alongside
usage.whole_episode_cost: unknown if any included call has unknown usage
usage.cached_input: count once, according to provider top-level accounting
usage.reasoning_output: included where provider reports it; do not add nested details a second time
usage.effective_speed: sum output tokens / sum full generation seconds per trajectory, then group median; not pure decoding speed

feedback_estimands.historical_detailed_display: extra detailed fields plus their input-length effect, conditional on updated known data and predictor
feedback_estimands.historical_adaptive_frozen: observed historical adaptive-workflow versus later frozen-workflow contrast; not an isolated component effect
feedback_estimands.new_context_factor: availability of the common-prefix new measurements and corresponding context, with predictor/selection held fixed
feedback_estimands.new_predictor_factor: predictor trained on initial data versus initial plus common-prefix measurements, on the same generated candidates
feedback_estimands.new_pilot_primary: within-state mean C1-minus-C0 under selector P0; equal state weights
new_pilot_secondary: predictor effect within each C condition
feedback_estimands.near_zero: does not establish equivalence or no effect
feedback_estimands.pilot_inference: descriptive feasibility/variance study; no confirmatory efficacy claim

record_completeness.aggregate_recalculation: selected values and summary arithmetic can be recalculated
record_completeness.process_audit: requires actual input, public response, complete proposals/rejections/scores, pre-query selection and post-query labels
record_completeness.new_stochastic_reproduction: fresh API output is a new run, not restoration of missing historical output
record_completeness.hidden_reasoning: not required or collected as scientific process evidence
